subject: several correlated covariates in QTL mapping

messages.author: ff9aaa860689d992
messages.subject: several correlated covariates in QTL mapping
parts:
Hi there,

I was hoping someone could give me some intuition on the effect of including several correlated covariates while searching for qtl i.e. using these covariates simultaneously in scanone(), addqtl().

I know the variance calculations become unstable when using correlated covariates in fitting models (e.g. fitqtl()), but any intuition on how they would affect the search for QTLs using scanone() and the like (e.g. addqtl) would be informative for my purposes.

best,
Saad
